title: The Commonwealth Mod
description: Adds a bunch of misc deco stuff, originally for use on a Commonwealth Server (currently defunct), But the Mod works!
body:
The Commonwealth Mod is a somewhat simple mod brought to you by Commonwealth Limited, Currently it features "missing" (by our standards) blocks we wanted, such as custom painted planks and a big custom road block set. Originally designed for a specific server but that is currently dead/limbo, but the Mod obviously still works so it might as well be released.

Current Features:
- Asphalt Road Set
- Road Sign Set
- Painted Plank Set
- Black and White Versions of a custom "Industrial" Window/Glass (with Pane options)
- Boxes of Misc Stuff (Basically compact storage like Iron/Gold/Diamond blocks but for other stuff)
- Survival Friendly
